text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, we still had plenty of time.
When I asked Duramente if there was anywhere
she wanted to go—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Then, off to the training gym.
choice_data_list: Today's a day to let your body rest.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Mmh... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She chose the planetarium.
After watching the starry sky, her expression is serene.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Outer space really is wonderful after all.
choice_data_list: You really like stargazing, don't you?
You really like stargazing, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When I feel the cosmos...
I can truly believe that I am the strongest.
choice_data_list: ...Hm? Outer space and the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...For example,
the distance between the Earth and the Moon is about 380,000 km."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: And the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) covers a distance of 2,400 meters. In other words, the Earth and the Moon are roughly 158,000 Derbies apart.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just like that vast universe,
I can become strong too... Thinking that brings me peace.
choice_data_list: ...I-Is that so...

text_block_list.text:
Words are full of "noise."
That's why... "connecting" is so difficult, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, "analysis" is possible. Outer space is vast...
and it makes my heart feel "warm."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You understand...? 
Indeed, when I turn my thoughts to the cosmos... 
deep within my chest, a fire ignites.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente spoke of the wonders of space that I had never understood, her eyes full of innocence.
...It made me want to understand where that passion came from.
choice_data_list: I want to feel the cosmos more, too.
I want to feel more of the cosmos too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's "UNDY." Then,
shall we all "observe"...
Neo Universe's "recommendation"?
choice_data_list: Yeah, please!
Yeah, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Led by Neo Universe, we walk through the forest.
It's a rugged path, but could there really be
a place ahead where you can feel the universe...?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let me know if it gets painful, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah. But, I'll do my best...!
Y-Yeah. But, I'll give it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next, you'll cross this unstable bridge.
It will shake quite a bit, but if you take it one step at a time—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Slip...!)
choice_data_list: Whoa—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I slip on the moss and nearly fall to my knees!
However, my body was completely uninjured.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Are you all right? ...Take my hand."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
From here on, it's gotta be even more "DGZN"...
This is our "turning point."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the path will only grow steeper.
What will you do? Will you turn back?
choice_data_list: No, we'll keep going like this!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how long had I been walking?
As dusk settled, the place I finally arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This is the "landing zone"—look up.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This is—
choice_data_list: It's so beautiful...!
It's so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
So much "DPSE"...
Here, I can "receive" it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's endless. Going on forever...
It feels like it stretches out to infinity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's profile as she gazes up at the starry sky.
Her eyes shine with innocent wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that is why the loneliness only deepens.
After all, I could never bring myself to believe
that I could ever become strong like her—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Desperately, with everything you had...
You tried to understand me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If you had given up on me,
we never would have gazed upon this universe together.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, I'm sure...
you would follow me no matter how far the destination.
choice_data_list: Duramente...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling as though all my fatigue had vanished into thin air... I called out to her.
choice_data_list: I want to look at all kinds of night skies with you!
I want to gaze at all kinds of night skies with you!
I hope I can feel the same way you do someday.
I hope someday I can feel the same way you do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling as though all my fatigue had vanished into thin air... I called out to her.
choice_data_list: I want to look at all kinds of night skies with you!
I want to gaze at all kinds of night skies with you!
I hope I can feel the same way you do someday.
I hope someday I can feel the same way you do.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I suppose... That's not bad either.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If Duramente wishes,
I will 'calculate'... the "observation point"?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...May I make a request?
I'm certain it will allow us to see a new cosmos.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I hope for the same.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You wish for "contact"? Then...
We tune our two "channels" together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean we should meet each other halfway?
If so... let us gaze at the universe just like this.
